q: The cut-set bound for a general relay network states that for any cut (S, Sᶜ) separating source from destination, the rate R satisfies:
opts: R ≤ max over cuts of I(X_S; Y_Sᶜ | X_Sᶜ)
R ≤ min over cuts of I(X_S; Y_Sᶜ | X_Sᶜ)
R ≤ Σ capacities of individual links
exp: The cut-set bound is the min over all cuts of the conditional mutual information across the cut. It is an upper bound on achievable rates and is tight for some network topologies (e.g., degraded relay channels).
